William Wordsworth, Samuel Taylor Coleridge, Lyrical Ballads.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-wordsworth_samuel-taylor-coleridge/lyrical-ballads

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Wordsworth, the author, died 1850.
- Samuel Taylor Coleridge, the author, died 1834.

First publication of the text used: 1798 (SE colophon: 'Lyrical Ballads was published in 1798 by William Wordsworth and Samuel Taylor Coleridge.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1798, before 1931. Under the United States 95-year rule, every publication of 1930 or earlier has been in the public domain since 1 January 2026 at the latest.
- Country of origin: the country of first publication does not change the result. Every person whose words are in the text died in 1850 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.
